in: Extend dietPlanStore with coach CRUD actions (fetchMentees, fetchCoachPlans, createPlan, updatePlan, deletePlan, fetchPlanForEdit)
Enhance /coach/diet-plans.vue list page with real data
Integrate /coach/diet-plans/new.vue with createPlan action + Zod validation

decisions.rationale: Existing coach_id FK on profiles; simple query; no new tables
Matches mock UI; scales better; clear hierarchy
RESTful; shareable URL; browser history works
Proactive UX; server constraint as safety net
Column exists in schema; low effort
Pure function of dates; no extra data
Pattern from statsStore.insertStat; no RPC needed
Simpler than diffing; cascade handles cleanup

tasks.title: Extend dietPlanStore with Coach CRUD Actions
tasks.description: Add coach-facing actions to useDietPlanStore: fetchMentees, fetchCoachPlans, createPlan, updatePlan, deletePlan, fetchPlanForEdit. Transactional insert for plan + meals + food_items.
tasks.verification: Run integration tests against local Supabase; verify rows in diet_plans, diet_plan_meals, diet_plan_food_items.

tasks.title: Enhance List Page (/coach/diet-plans.vue)
tasks.description: Replace mock data with real fetchMentees + fetchCoachPlans. Show mentees grouped with their plans. Each plan shows: name, date range, status badge (active/upcoming/expired), actions (View, Edit).
tests: Integration: Page loads mentees + plans from store
Unit: Status badge logic (active/upcoming/expired based on date)
tasks.verification: Manual check in browser; coach sees real data.

tasks.title: Create Plan Page - Backend Integration (/coach/diet-plans/new.vue)
tasks.description: Replace mock save with dietPlanStore.createPlan. Add Zod validation schema for plan form. Connect FoodSelector to meal builder. Meal macros display using sumMacros. On success, redirect to list with toast.
tests: Unit: Zod schema validates required fields, date logic
Integration: Submit creates plan + meals + items in DB
tasks.verification: Create plan in browser; verify in Supabase dashboard.

tasks.title: Edit Plan Page (/coach/diet-plans/[id]/edit.vue)
tasks.description: New page. Fetch plan with meals/items via fetchPlanForEdit. Pre-populate form. Same meal builder as create. On save, call updatePlan. On delete, call deletePlan with confirmation.
tests: Integration: fetchPlanForEdit loads full plan structure
tasks.verification: Edit existing plan in browser; verify changes persist.

tasks.title: Add Coach Mentee Fetching to Profile Store
tasks.description: Add fetchMyMentees() to useProfileStore. Query profiles where role='mentee' AND coach_id=auth.uid(). Used by create/edit pages for mentee dropdown.

tasks.title: Unit Tests for Macro Utilities
tasks.description: Add Vitest unit tests for calculateMacros and sumMacros in app/utils/foodMacros.ts.
tests: calculateMacros scales correctly for various quantities
sumMacros returns zeros for empty array
